I routinely suffered from carpal tunnel, and regardless of which keyboard I used or how I took care of my typing habits, it was always painful. My hand would burn, and my productivity would drop.

Now, with Wispr Flow, this is godsent for me. I had vibe-coded a similar app for myself using a local model, but then I found Wispr Flow. I have been recommending it to everybody. Everybody in my family and at my work uses it, and I certainly believe it helps me improve my productivity, work on the go, and be more engaged at work rather than worried about what information I need to take down.

How effective and productive can I be if my medical condition returns again? Can't rate it enough for myself
